messages:
elaine: Quick async — need to lock private deploy packaging decisions for Wed customer workshop. Focus: minimal installer, upgrade lanes, and allowlist wording.
jasper: Proposed profiles: 'thin' (no relay) and 'ops' (relay + support hooks). CLI-first for alpha to move faster.
maria: Field note: customers want a copy-paste allowlist snippet and a one-page NetOps checklist for firewall teams.
netops: We'll draft a checklist: required egress IPs, control-plane DNS names, TLS SNI expectations, and a simple port 443 curl check.
frank: Infra note: minor semver bumps = rolling operator upgrades (short pod drains, expected 20-40s per node). Major schema changes = explicit migration + maintenance window. KV cache compatibility only guaranteed for minor bumps.
jasper: Installer preflight will validate DNS, TLS handshake to control-plane, outbound egress, and operator RBAC. Preflight failures must surface remediation steps.
maria: Pilot asks: staged canary (1 node or 5% tenants), automatic revert on error spike, and a manual revert token to force rollback.
deploy-bot: Jira RDW-PRIV-3217 created: "thin/ops packaging + preflight checks + allowlist doc".
elaine: Action items: jasper - installer templates + preflight (1w); netops - 1p checklist + allowlist snippet (1w); maria - recruit pilots (2w); frank - draft major upgrade runbook (2w). Flag blockers here. :thumbsup:
